entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And it's not just 'not satisfied', it's that your sizing is a complete joke. I ordered a jersey and it's the wrong size entirely.

I understand your frustration. Let me pull up that order. Okay, I see the Pro-Series Aero Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, is the issue a technical fault with the material, or is it a matter of preference with the fit?

Are you listening to me? It's too tight! I can barely breathe in it! This isn't a 'preference', it's a defective product. I want my money back, not an interrogation. Just process the return or get me your manager right now. I swear I will light you up on every review site on the internet.

I apologize, that was not my intention. I completely understand wanting a product that fits you perfectly. You do not need to speak with a manager; I can certainly handle this for you. Let me just confirm the purchase date... I see it was delivered 42 days ago.
And? What are you trying to pull? Your website says 90 days. Don't you dare try to get out of this.

Not at all, sir. You are absolutely correct. Our policy is 90 days for a full refund, and you are well within that window. I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I can see you're one of our VIP members, and I want to sincerely apologize for the frustration this has caused. I have gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you.
Waived the fee? That's the least you could do. This whole experience has been a waste of my time.

I agree, and I'd like to make it right. In addition to the free return, I've added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase. We value your business, and we hope you'll give us another chance to provide the quality you expect. Would you be interested in an exchange for a larger size, or would you prefer to stick with the full refund?
Oh. A credit? Well... fine. Okay. Just the refund for now. I'll think about using the credit later. So what happens next?

Of course. I've just sent the prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the jersey, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
